title: A Primer of Green Things
summary: For children and beginners. Nothing in here will hurt you. — Lantern Street Schoolroom

pages.text: Soak the seed overnight {~in water that has seen the moon~}, then plant it {~a knuckle deep~}. It comes up eager, and it {~climbs~}.
Work the ash {~into the bed~} in autumn and the {?skellis?} in spring. {~Turn it twice, never thrice.~}
Pull one of each and lay them in a row on the path. {~The ones that wilt first~} were never yours to keep.
Prop a slate {~against the south wind~} and say {~the seedling's name~} each morning. It grows {~straighter for being known~}.
A cut stem tells its years {~to anyone patient with a lens~}. Wet the cut first.
